feeds.description: Sorted by feed, then origin (absent first); no duplicate (feed, origin). Verifiers that predate this field reject the block.

main.description: Block in a key attestation listing the (botDid, type) and (feed, origin, type) pairs an importer may re-publish. Holds sources, feeds or both, each non-empty.

feed.description: Feed ID: the NSID of the feed definition (attest.importer §1.1), e.g. dev.jisaku.mosimo.public.jma.

origin.description: Issuer of the originals as an absolute URI. Absent: every issuer of the feed.

items.description: Information type defined by the feed definition; for dev.jisaku.mosimo.public.jma the original Control/Title.

types.description: Sorted, no duplicates. Absent: every type of the feed.

botDid.description: Author DID of the original posts.

items.description: Information type; the value of the bsaf type: tag without prefix.
